@Bettina, I couldn't set up the weekly digest. The scheduler refused the job: it has no gateway credentials, and the OpenClaw setup agent can't sign in to the AI service. Nothing is scheduled, so no digest will post on Monday 19 October until someone sets it up.

Here's the spec, ready for whoever has admin access to the Gateway:
- **When:** every Monday at 08:00 America/Chicago (cron `0 8 * * 1`), starting Monday 19 October 2026.
- **Where:** post in #coastal-team, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random.
- **What:** the previous week's activity from both channels, plus open customer items. The digest would leave out money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts, payment terms) and finance documents, because #coastal-team's members don't all have finance access. Seat counts, renewal dates, ticket numbers and contacts are fine to include.

I can retry the job creation once the Gateway credentials or AI sign-in are fixed. If you'd rather post the first digest by hand, I can draft it for you here.
